notes.title: THE SCREEN (Playtest) - Patch Notes
notes.notes: [list][*][p][Add] Added the option to reduce flashing effects in the game menu. The option is also presented to the player at the beginning of the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]The following contains spoilers:[/p][list][*][p][Fix] [spoiler]Fixed the bug that caused the player to be able to move when examing items[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p][Fix] (Hotfix) [spoiler]Temporarily disabled the ability to exam items when the elevator is descending[/spoiler].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues after the update, feel free to contact through the [url="https://forms.gle/wrQmhNBzJY5hwjDb6"]bug report Google Form[/url].[/p]
